reference_policy.fallback: If task-level baseline has fewer than 5 samples, the global baseline is used. If the global baseline is also too small, only hard rules are applied.
reference_policy.statistics: median, MAD, p01, p05, p95, p99, min, max

policy.rotation6d: precheck finite values, vector norms, and non-collinearity before SO(3) conversion
policy.bimanual: enabled only when state_frame_mode is common_world
policy.state_vision: uses feature-track motion and duplicate-frame gating when OpenCV is available; otherwise reports unavailable
policy.calibration: strict reprojection, epipolar, and triangulation are disabled when calibration_mode is none
